title: Complex embeddings of a number field
statement:
Let $L$ be a number field [def-weil-number-field]. Define

$$
\operatorname{Emb}_{\mathbf Q}(L,\mathbf C)=\{\tau:L\longrightarrow\mathbf C:\tau\text{ is a field homomorphism and }\tau|_{\mathbf Q}=\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf Q}\},
$$

the set of field homomorphisms from $L$ to the field $\mathbf C$ of complex numbers that are the identity on the prime field $\mathbf Q\subset L$. (Every field homomorphism $L\to\mathbf C$ is injective and restricts to the identity on $\mathbf Q$, since it sends $1$ to $1$ and preserves sums, differences and quotients; so the condition $\tau|_{\mathbf Q}=\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf Q}$ is automatic and $\operatorname{Emb}_{\mathbf Q}(L,\mathbf C)$ is the set of all field homomorphisms $L\to\mathbf C$, the *complex embeddings* of $L$.)
